description: Answer a needs_input question (credentials, OTP, platform, device, monorepo target) and get the next call. Secrets (passwords/OTP/tokens) are redacted at once and never echoed or logged (flows use ${VAR}). Non-secret choices map onto the re-invocation args. Returns accepted, ignored[], projectRoot, nextAction; with no new consent needed it starts the resumed job (jobId).

values.description: Field name > value. Secret fields are redacted on receipt.
